notes: Held-out tasks (round 2), written after v0.2's tuning and before any kopt measurement on them; not derived from bench/results/failures.md. Gold read in the code with git grep and sed only. Re-check with `kopt bench bench/tasks-heldout/playframework.json --verify`.

tasks.question: How does Play's gzip filter decide whether to compress a response (the client's Accept-Encoding preference, the response status, an existing content encoding, the body size)?
tasks.search: gzip filter compress response accept encoding status already encoded size threshold
tasks.verifiedBy: Read GzipFilter: mayCompress requires gzipIsAcceptedAndPreferredBy (q-values of Accept-Encoding); handleResult compresses when shouldCompress (status not 204/304, no Content-Encoding yet, non-empty body above config.threshold) and config.shouldGzip agree.

tasks.question: Where does Play build the Content-Security-Policy header values from a CSP result?
tasks.search: content security policy header values csp result nonce
tasks.verifiedBy: Read CSPResultProcessor: DefaultCSPResultProcessor.generateHeaders turns the CSPResult directives (and report-only flag) into the Content-Security-Policy(-Report-Only) header pairs.
